name_translated.en: 2024 PSES Employment Equity Derived Variable Dataset
name_translated.fr: SAFF 2024 Ensemble de données variables dérivées sur l'équité en matière d'emploi

note: Official department-level results, no aggregation. Resource title explicitly identifies 2024 PSES despite ses-2025 directory name. Values 9999 and other source suppression flags must not be interpreted as zero.
extraction_method: Open Government CKAN datastore_search API, resource_id fa2dc381-0d55-44d8-8d1d-3fb2f7f2b9f8, filters LEVEL1ID=05 and LEVEL2ID=LEVEL3ID=LEVEL4ID=LEVEL5ID=0, all pages of 1000 records.
encoding: Lossless column dictionaries in gzip/base64. Reconstructed records were compared cell-for-cell with the source extract; no suppressed cells were filled.
suppression_note: X and null indicate suppressed/unavailable;9999 indicates not applicable metric. Do not turn into zero or infer zero respondents.
